meaning:
ἀ-κατά-κριτος, -ον
(κατακρίνω),
1. uncondemned (EV): Act.16:37, 22:25.
2. = cl. ἄκριτος, without trial, not yet tried (MM, VGT, see word) Ac, ll. cc.
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No…
